pages.text: $(l)Mana Bloom$() scatters mystical generating flowers across the battlefield.$(br2)$(l)Max Level:$() 5$(br)$(l)Type:$() Utility$(br)$(l)Botania Mana Cost:$() 10,000 + 10,000/level$(br2)At higher levels, more flowers are spawned across a wider area. The flowers are temporary and vanish after a short time, but they generate small amounts of Botania mana while active.

pages.title: Scribing the Scroll
pages.text: Scrolls are not crafted at a table. Set a $(l)Scroll Forge$() with $(l)Common Ink$() and a Botany focus — a $(l)Spell Petal$(), a $(l)Botanical Focus$(), or any item tagged $(t)#ironsbotany:focus/botany$() — then choose $(l)Mana Bloom$() from the spell list.$(br2)The ink rarity sets the highest spell level the forge will scribe, so richer ink is the only way to reach the upper levels of this spell.
